03-27-1186 is March 27, 1186.  
Subtract 180 days:  
March 27 back 27 days → March 1.  
Remaining 180 - 27 = 153 days earlier.  
February 1186 had 29 days (leap year: 1186 divisible by 4? 1186/4 = 296.5, no, so 28 days).  
January 31 days, December 31 days, November 30 days, October 31 days, September 30 days.  
Back from March 1:  
Feb (28) → Jan 1 (31) → Dec 1 (31) → Nov 1 (30) → Oct 1 (31) → Sep 1 (30) → Aug 2.  
Count: 27 + 28 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 2 = 180 days back.  
Thus new date is August 2, 1185.
